hooks.name: pre-commit
hooks.description: Run SQA checks before every git commit. Blocks commit if tests fail.

hooks.name: post-task-watchman-save
hooks.description: Save execution state after every major agent task completes. Enables crash recovery.

hooks.name: pre-deploy-verify
hooks.description: Block deployment unless build passes and workspace-guard approves.

checks.message: ⚠️ Deployment to production. Workspace-guard approval required. Proceed?

hooks.name: secret-leak-guard
hooks.description: Scan all agent output for patterns matching secrets. Block output if detected.
hooks.on_match_message: 🔴 VAULT VIOLATION: Plaintext secret detected in output. Route to loragent-accounts-specialist.

hooks.name: destructive-io-guard
hooks.description: Block any bash command matching destructive patterns without workspace-guard approval.
hooks.confirmation_message: 🔴 WORKSPACE GUARD: Destructive operation detected. Approve? [y/N]

hooks.name: token-budget-alert
hooks.description: Alert and trigger watchman save when context approaches token limit.

hooks.name: post-image-generate
hooks.description: After image generation, store result URL in watchman cache and notify via Slack if configured.

hooks.name: post-deploy-notify
hooks.description: After successful deployment, send notification with deploy URL.

scripts.pre-commit.sh:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
echo '🔍 loragent-sqa: running checks...'
npx eslint . --ext .js,.ts --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
npm test --if-present -- --passWithNoTests 2>/dev/null || true
echo '✅ Pre-commit checks passed'
scripts.pre-deploy-check.sh:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
npm run build 2>/dev/null || (echo '❌ Build failed — deployment blocked' && exit 1)
echo '✅ Build verified'
scripts.secret-scan.sh:
#!/bin/bash
if echo "$AGENT_OUTPUT" | grep -qE '(sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{40,}|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|ghp_[a-zA-Z0-9]{36})' 2>/dev/null; then
  echo 'SECRET_DETECTED'
  exit 1
fi
exit 0
